_meta.about: Example documents for every collection in the Anchorcare cognitive memory schema.
_meta.format: MongoDB Extended JSON (relaxed). Keys are collection names; values are arrays of documents.
_meta.warning: Fictional household. Every record here is caregiver-approved demo data. Do not seed a cluster that holds real patient data.

working_memory.content: Morning medication reminder had no response at 08:10.

sources.content: Sarah came over at half two and they sat in the garden with tea. She brought the seaside photographs from the album. Margaret was in good spirits and talked about the pier.
Two women seated at a small table in a garden, teacups and a photo album between them.
